name: model-router
description: Routes each turn and each subagent to Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 or Opus 5.5 by task difficulty, keeping prompt caches warm, and keeps a cost ledger.

mainRouting.title: Main loop routing
mainRouting.description: route: pick a model per turn; fixed: leave the main loop on the session's model.

classifier.title: Turn classifier
classifier.description: heuristic: keywords and length only (no extra call); hybrid: ask Haiku only when the heuristic is unsure; haiku: always ask Haiku.

stickyContextTokens.title: Sticky context size
stickyContextTokens.description: Once the main conversation's prompt is this many tokens or more, the router never steps down a tier, since a switch rewrites the whole prompt cache on the new model.

subagentRouting.title: Route subagents
subagentRouting.description: Pick a model for subagents whose caller named none.

report.title: Per-turn report
report.description: turn: log the tier, tokens and estimated cost after each main turn (an SDK host receives it as ui_log); off: only /router-stats.
